title: Settings
subtitle: Manage LLM providers, API keys, and preferences

providers.title: LLM Providers
providers.description: Add your own API keys. All keys are encrypted with PBKDF2 + AES-256.

dialog.title: Add LLM Provider
dialog.description: Configure a new LLM provider. Your API key will be encrypted before storage.
dialog.keySecurityNote: Encrypted with PBKDF2 + AES-256 before storage. Never sent to client.

github.title: GitHub Connection
github.tokenNote: Store your GitHub token in Settings to enable file sync. Token is kept in localStorage for privacy.

localFolder.title: Local Folder
localFolder.linked: Local folder linked — files available for pipeline context.
localFolder.description: Link a local folder to use its files directly in pipeline context — no Git required. The folder stays on your machine.
localFolder.browserNotSupported: Interactive folder selection requires Chrome or Edge. The File System Access API is not available in this browser.
localFolder.apiNote: Uses the File System Access API. The folder handle is stored locally in your browser's IndexedDB.
localFolder.fallbackNote: Files are available during this session. Re-link after page refresh.

dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataManagement.description: Download a full backup of your data or restore from a previous backup. All data stays on your machine.
dataManagement.chatDataDesc: Save your current chat history to the server so it persists across sessions.
dataManagement.noMessages: No messages in memory to save. Open a project and chat first.
dataManagement.fullBackupDesc: Download all your data — projects, agents, pipelines, preferences, and test fixtures — as a JSON file.
dataManagement.restoreDesc: Upload a previously downloaded backup file to restore agents, pipelines, and preferences.
dataManagement.restoreConfirm:
Restore backup from {{date}}?

This will merge agents, templates, and preferences with your current data. Existing items won't be overwritten.
dataManagement.invalidBackup: Invalid backup file. Expected a Swarm Studio full backup.

agents.title: Agent Configuration
agents.description: Customize the 4-agent cascade pipeline for this project.

modelPrices.title: Model prices you declare
modelPrices.description: When neither a provider's published list nor a configured price vector knows a model, the platform records its cost as unknown. State the rate yourself here so that part of your spend stops being a blank.
modelPrices.required: Pick a provider and enter a model id.
modelPrices.invalidNumber: Both rates must be numbers of 0 or more.
modelPrices.zeroHint: 0 is a real zero, not a blank: use it for a model you run locally, and its calls are recorded as costing nothing.
modelPrices.priorityHint: Your number is used last. A provider's published price or a configured price vector always wins, and if two of your own credentials disagree about one model id the cost stays unknown rather than guessed.

marketplaceLink.title: Marketplace account
marketplaceLink.description: Link this local install to your deewaanai.com account to publish your pipelines or fork shared ones. Everything still runs on this computer — the marketplace only stores listings and evidence.
marketplaceLink.codeInstruction: Open the link below and approve this code:
marketplaceLink.linked: Linked — publishing and forking are enabled.
marketplaceLink.linkFailed: Could not reach the marketplace. Try again.
